scope: Focused correction of the PostgreSQL race-test observer, not a replacement full gate
observed_defect: A transaction that reads pg_stat_activity before a new contender connects can retain a snapshot without that backend; repeatedly reading that snapshot cannot prove the contender is waiting
correction: Refresh the statistics snapshot before each bounded pg_blocking_pids observation; retain the actual blocking assertion, independent sessions and event barriers
limitations: The failed canonical gate retained only its output tail; the independent reproduction proves this observer defect, not the discarded original traceback. Subsequent complete gates remain required.
